reasoning: The agent maintained an explicit subsystem ledger (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate) through the whole build and then ran a systematic final reconciliation covering the full requirement set, marking areas verified and catching/closing dropped items (CW count, reply count), which matches the level-8 anchor of explicit granular status plus gap detection. It falls short of 10 because the tracked artifact was coarse (6 tasks) rather than a continuously reconciled per-gate picture, and there is no clear evidence of risk-weighted effort allocation or explicit early detection/redirect of circular debugging.
